issue_context.title: LIFX service call interference
issue_context.body:
### The problem

My LIFX automations with transitions are wonky since 2022.8. Below is a simple reproducer that used to work fine but now the light barely turns on. It seems like the `turn_off` call stops the default fade-on transition of the `turn_on` call before it reaches 80%. If I comment in the delay, the script works as it used to.

This is probably related to #77646 but the situation is quite different so I opened a new issue in order to not confuse things.

(Full disclosure: I am actually using AppDaemon, I converted my failing automation to a `script` to create this issue)

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.8.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.7.x

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

LIFX

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/lifx/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
script:
  on_slowly_off:
    sequence:
      - service: light.turn_on
        data:
          entity_id: light.krea
          brightness_pct: 80
          kelvin: 3500
      # - delay: {milliseconds: 250}
      - service: light.turn_off
        data:
          entity_id: light.krea
          transition: 600
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

```yaml
      # setup

```
